question_text: Outline a role of each of TCP, HTTPS and DHCP in a networked application.
adaptation_rationale: Replaces generic unrestricted protocol functions with three transport/application protocols explicitly named in guide.
solution: TCP provides ordered reliable delivery using acknowledgements/retransmission. HTTPS protects HTTP communication using TLS, reducing disclosure/tampering. DHCP supplies network configuration such as an IP address automatically.

marking_points.criterion: Expansion reduces manual configuration/conflicts through managed leases.
